zh-CN.audience: 需要在 weapp-vite 工程中评估结构化本地数据、离线存储和数据库迁移的小程序团队。

faqs.question: 目前验证了哪些运行环境？
faqs.answer: Web 与真实微信开发者工具已通过自动验收，微信 iOS 与 Android 真机仍待验证。本站按测试版展示；其他小程序平台目前仅提供构建与 unsupported 契约，不代表正式运行支持。

faqs.question: 应该安装哪个包？
faqs.answer: weapp-vite 工程推荐安装 @weapp-sqlite/weapp-vite，注册 weappSqlite() 插件后从其 runtime 入口导入 openSqlite。具体配置和平台边界以官方文档为准。

en.name: weapp-sqlite
en.tagline: A local data layer for mini-app projects
en.description: Integrate SQLite WASM through weapp-vite for unified asynchronous queries, transactions, migrations, and local persistence. Web and WeChat DevTools pass automated acceptance; WeChat devices await verification. Listed here as Beta.
en.audience: Mini-app teams evaluating structured local data, offline storage, and database migrations in weapp-vite projects.
useCases: Integrate local SQLite into a weapp-vite project
Query structured data and manage transactions and migrations
Verify persistence on Web and WeChat DevTools
capabilities: Unified asynchronous queries, transactions, and migrations
IndexedDB on Web and file-system persistence on WeChat

faqs.question: Which environments have been verified?
faqs.answer: Web and real WeChat DevTools pass automated acceptance. WeChat iOS and Android devices await verification, so this site lists the project as Beta. Other mini-app platforms currently provide build output and an unsupported contract, which does not imply official runtime support.

faqs.question: Which package should I install?
faqs.answer: For weapp-vite projects, install @weapp-sqlite/weapp-vite, register weappSqlite(), then import openSqlite from its runtime entry. Follow the official documentation for configuration and platform boundaries.
